title: Google Chrome third-party cookie phaseout
author: magda_leroux
content:
Google Chrome third-party cookie phaseout
KB003710
PRODUCT
Nintex K2 Cloud, Nintex Automation
BASED ON
Nintex K2 Cloud, Nintex Automation 
 
Google is rolling out changes to block third-party cookies in the Google Chrome browser. This affects Nintex K2 for SharePoint and Nintex Automation for SharePoint which loads Nintex K2 forms in an iframe. Due to the SharePoint and Nintex K2 sites being on different domains, if blocking of third-party cookies is enabled this results in login failures due to authentication cookies that cannot be set by the browser.
See 
Prepare for the third-party cookie phaseout
 for more information about timelines.
 
Issue
Authentication or redirect errors when navigating to SharePoint Online or SharePoint On Premise forms or webparts.
 
Resolution
See the following topics in the latest help documentation for information about resolving these issues:
Nintex Automation: 
Google Chrome third-party cookie phaseout
 
K2 Cloud: 
Google Chrome third-party cookie phaseout
